articles.summary: Tournament weekends have a rhythm of their own. When the gear piles up, and the schedule starts early, the right bags for weekends away with the team turn chaos into something that actually feels manageable. This is when you need bags that hold what you need, stay organized under pressure, and still look great. Here's a simple lineup that keeps the whole weekend moving. The Pack-It-All Power Player Some trips are all about perfectly folded outfits and color-coded packing lists. Tournament travel is not one of them. This is where a bag that can handle multiple demands really earns its keep. Our Large Original Duffel is roomy enough for uniforms, extra layers, and that spare hoodie that always ends up saving the day. With a wide interior, three inside slip pockets, and easy-access exterior pockets, it keeps the essentials where you can actually find them. Why it works for tournament weekends: • Spacious interior for clothes, shoes, and extra layers • Exterior pockets for quick-grab items • Comfortable shoulder drop for easy carry from the parking lot to the hotel lobby • Durable design ready for repeat weekends on the road • Dimensions: 22.0" w x 11.5" h x 11.5" d For the Trips That Go the Extra Distance Some tournaments mean a hotel stay for a night. Or two. Or three if your team's on a winning streak! The Adair Rolling Duffel steps in when the packing list grows beyond the weekend basics. It combines the flexibility of a duffel with the convenience of wheels, because no one wants to haul a heavy bag through a lobby at 6 a.m. This one stands upright on its own, rolls smoothly behind you, and includes a telescoping handle that makes navigating airports, parking garages, and hotel hallways surprisingly painless. Its travel-ready features include: • An upright structure that keeps things organized • A telescoping handle and wheels for easy rolling • An interior mesh zip pocket for separating smaller items • Exterior zip pockets for documents, chargers, or last-minute essentials. • Dimensions: 21.0" w x 13.0" h x 10.0" d Stay Hands-Free in the Stands When you're cheering, filming highlights, and juggling snacks, the last thing you want is a bulky bag sliding off your shoulder. Our Original Zip Hipster is built for movement. Three zippered compartments keep your phone, wallet, and keys organized while the adjustable strap keeps everything comfortably hands-free. It's sleek, secure, and small enough to stay out of your way while you focus on the moment. Why it's perfect for long days of competition: • A lightweight crossbody design • Three zip compartments for organized game-day essentials • An adjustable strap that's more comfortable to wear for long periods of time • Compact size that moves easily from bus ride to field to stands • Dimensions: 11.0" w x 9.0" h x 2.75" d For the Traditional Tote Bag Fans Prefer a traditional tote bag when traveling to games? The Small Original Vera Tote brings the classic Vera Bradley look into a more compact, everyday-friendly size. It's structured enough to stay organized, yet light enough to carry through a full day of games. With six interior slip pockets, plus exterior storage, everything has a place, from sunglasses to snacks to tournament merch. Why fans love it for away-game weekends: • A compact size that still holds daily essentials • Six interior slip pockets for organization • Exterior slip and zip pockets for quick access • Quilted cotton lining that feels as good as it looks • Dimensions: 11.5" w x 11.5" h x 4.5" d The Find-It-Fast Organizer There's something deeply satisfying about knowing exactly where everything is, especially when you're on the move. This Large Cosmetic Bag keeps makeup, skincare, and travel-size toiletries together in one easy-to-grab place. Its spacious interior means no digging through your duffel at midnight trying to find a face wash. Zip it, toss it in your bag, and know that your routine is ready whenever the day finally slows down. Tournament weekend perks: • A spacious interior for makeup and skincare • A durable, easy-clean design for travel • An exterior zip pocket for smaller essentials • Dimensions: 10.25" w x 7.75" h x 4.0" d The Secret Weapon of Organized Travelers Here's a quiet truth about packing: the smaller systems make the biggest difference. Our 3 Pouch Organizer Set turns a big bag into a perfectly sorted one. One pouch for tech cords, one for snacks, one for travel essentials, it's entirely up to you. And when it's time to head to the stands? Just pull one out and drop it into your crossbody or tote. Why tournament travelers swear by them: • Three sizes so you can organize things your way • Zip closures that keep everything secure • Moves easily from your duffel to whatever smaller bag you're carrying • Bright and eye-catching prints and patterns make finding things easy • Dimensions: Large 12.5" w x 8.75" h x 4.5" d, Medium 9" w x 6" h x 3.75" d, Small 6.5" w x 4" h x 1.75" d Because Bleachers Get Cold Thanks to early mornings, late games, and breezy sidelines, this Plush Throw Blanket will quietly become the most appreciated item in your car or in the stands (especially for ice hockey moms!). Soft, generously sized, and easy to pack, it's perfect for wrapping up in the stands, warming up in the hotel room, or grabbing during the drive home. Why it earns a permanent spot in your tournament travel kit: • The feel of its ultra-soft plush fabric • It's large (50" x 80") size so you can wrap yourself and a friend up • It's easy to keep in a vehicle or bag when needed • Dimensions: 50.0" w x 80.0" h A Better Way to Pack for Tournament Travel Travel team weekends don't have to feel frantic for kids or parents. With the right bags for tournament travel, you can build a simple packing system that works every time: • A large duffel or rolling bag for clothes and gear • A crossbody or tote for quick access in the stands • Organizers and pouches to keep essentials sorted • A blanket when temps get chilly Draft your perfect lineup of bags for tournament travel and head into every game prepared and organized! articles.summary: Every brand has a beginning. Ours just happened to give way to a bag that became a forever favorite. The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag wasn’t designed to be iconic. It was designed to be carried every day, everywhere by women who had places to go and no interest in carrying something boring to get there. It was practical without looking practical. Pretty without trying too hard. Structured, but still soft enough to feel lived-in from day one. And maybe that’s why it stuck. This wasn’t just another Vera Bradley handbag. It was the one that proved you could have thoughtful organization, a timeless shape, and personality all in one bag. That’s exactly what makes it unforgettable! Why It Still Works (And Always Will) The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag isn’t trying to reinvent itself every season. It doesn’t need to. The proportions are right. The shape is right. The details are right. It’s roomy enough for what you actually carry, compact enough to never feel bulky. It’s the kind of bag you grab without thinking twice because you already know it works. Its handle drop is long enough to sit comfortably on your shoulder, yet easy to carry without the need for constant adjusting or tucking it under your arm. It’s subtle, but those details matter. You feel them in the way the bag moves with you. Plenty of Pockets for Everything You Need Every Day We’ve always believed a bag should make your day smoother, not more chaotic. Inside the Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag you’ll find five interior slip pockets. That means your phone isn’t hiding under your sunglasses and your keys aren’t always at the bottom of the bag. All of your essentials have a place. On the outside, you’ll find two slip pockets for the things you reach for constantly, like your phone, ID badge, or lip balm. And the zip closure keeps everything secure without ruining the clean lines of the bag. It’s a practical design made by people who actually carry handbags. Different Decades. Same Good Taste. The Original 100 Handbag was launched by Vera Bradley founders Patricia R. Miller and Barbara Bradley Baekgaard in 1982, back when bags were bland and colorful patterns were seldom found. Adding colorful patterns and prints to tote bags was a bold move that many found joyful. Although the Original 100 Handbag has plenty of history, it doesn’t feel stuck in the past. A new generation is discovering the Vera Bradley handbag that started it all. And they’re styling it their own way. With vintage denim, tailored blazers, sneakers, heels, or whatever feels right today. It works all of these looks because it doesn’t dictate. It’s not about nostalgia. It’s about confidence. It’s The Details That Matter Now that you know the vibe, let’s get into the specifics of this classic bag. What are the Dimensions of the Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag? It measures 11" wide x 5 ¾” high x 5 ¾” deep. It’s compact but roomy enough for your daily essentials. What is the Handle Drop? The handle drop is 13 ½”, making it easy to carry comfortably on your shoulder. How Many Pockets Does It Have? You’ll find five interior slip pockets for organization inside and two exterior slip pockets for quick-access items. It also features a zip closure to keep everything contained and secure while maintaining its classic silhouette. Is This a Good Everyday Bag? That’s exactly what it was designed for. It’s structured enough to look polished, practical enough to handle your real life, and timeless enough to carry for years. Plus, the bag is made with our signature quilted cotton which is durable and machine washable, all while looking great for years. The Original 100 Handbag: Fits Your Life and Not Just Your Outfit Trends are fun. We love them. But favorites? Favorites are different. Favorites are the bags you reach for without thinking. The ones that already know your routine. The ones that somehow look better the more you carry them. The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag isn’t trying to be the loudest bag in the room. It wants to be the one you trust. SHOP THE ORIGINAL 100 HANDBAG

articles.summary: The itinerary is set. The playlist is locked. The group chat has officially reached "we should all wear this at brunch" levels of enthusiasm. Now comes the part that can make or break the vibe: packing. If you've ever stared at a bed covered in outfit options, wondering how this escalated so quickly, you're not alone. The secret to how to pack for a weekend getaway isn't bringing more; it's bringing smarter. Think mix-and-match outfits, shoes that won't betray you halfway through the night, a beauty kit that travels well, and a weekend bag that keeps everything in its place. Start With Your Girls Weekend Bag A girls trip moves fast. Coffee runs turn into shopping, shopping turns into sunset cocktails. Suddenly, someone suggests dancing. Your bag needs to keep up. Our Large Miramar Weekender is built for exactly that kind of trip. Spacious without feeling oversized, it's the kind of bag that makes packing feel easy instead of chaotic. With a roomy main compartment, a dedicated laptop pocket, and thoughtful interior pockets, it keeps your essentials organized without requiring a packing spreadsheet. Slip your tablet or laptop into the padded compartment, stash quick-grab items in the front slip pocket, and take advantage of the interior pockets to keep smaller things from wandering around the bottom of your bag. The Mix-and-Match Outfit Strategy Packing light doesn't mean packing boring. The trick is choosing pieces that work together in different ways. Here's an easy way to plan your outfits: • Two casual daytime outfits • One brunch-ready look • One "just in case we go somewhere nice" outfit • A lightweight layer for cool evenings • Comfortable shoes you can actually walk in When everything coordinates, you can pack fewer pieces while still having options. And yes, this strategy leaves room for an “I bought something cute, and now I need space to bring it home” situation. Your Beauty Routine, Travel Edition Keeping beauty products organized while traveling shouldn't feel like solving a puzzle. The Medium Cosmetic Bag (Dimensions: 9.0" w x 5.25" h x 3.25" d) gives you enough room for makeup, skincare, and toiletries while keeping everything contained and easy to find. Pair it with our Upright Product Organizer (Dimensions: 5.75" w x 8.75" h x 5.75" d), designed specifically to hold bottles upright so they don't spill or leak mid-trip. The structured design and elastic loops keep products in place, so you don't have to worry about dealing with any lotion explosions when you unpack. Together, they make your beauty routine feel just as organized on the road as it does at home. Chargers, Cords, and the Tangle You Didn't Sign Up For Between GPS duty, photos, group texts, restaurant reservations, and rideshares, your phone works overtime on a girls weekend. Enter our Cord Organizer, a compact lifesaver designed to keep chargers, earbuds, and cables neatly contained. Inside, mesh pockets make it easy to see what's where, while the zip closure keeps everything secure inside your bag. Dimensions: 8.5" w x 6.5" h x 2.0" d No more digging through your weekend bag looking for the one charger you swear you packed. A Going Out Bag That Doesn't Slow You Down When the group decides to wander a new neighborhood or squeeze in one more stop before heading back, you want something light and easy. Our Woodward Small Belt Bag (Dimensions: 7.5" w x 4.75" h x 2.0" d) keeps things hands-free while holding your essentials (phone, cards, keys, and lip balm) in a sleek, compact silhouette. Three interior card pockets and a key loop help keep everything secure, while the adjustable strap lets you wear it your way. Prefer something a little more classic? The Clip & Zip Wristlet (Dimensions: 6.0" w x 4.0" h x 0.5" d) is the perfect grab-and-go companion. It slips easily onto your wrist or clips inside your larger bag, keeping your cards and small essentials right where you need them. Sun Protection That Looks Good Doing It A girls weekend usually includes brunch patios, beach walks, or spontaneous sightseeing. Dall Polarized Sunglasses deliver style, comfort, and UV protection all in one. Polarized lenses reduce glare, while your choice of signature Vera Bradley prints adds a subtle design detail that makes them feel special. To keep them protected in your bag, tuck them into the Double Eye Case, which holds two pairs of glasses in one compact case. It's perfect if you travel with both sunglasses and reading glasses, or if your best friend inevitably forgets hers. The Girls Weekend Packing Checklist If you're wondering how to pack for a weekend getaway, this quick list keeps things streamlined: • Mix-and-match outfits • Comfortable walking shoes • A lightweight layer • Beauty essentials in travel-size containers • Phone chargers and headphones • Sunglasses and a case • Snacks and a reusable water bottle • A compact bag for exploring Pack it all inside your favorite girls weekend bag, and suddenly the whole trip feels easier. Now You Know How to Weekend With a smart bag, a few thoughtful organizers, and essentials that travel well, your girls weekend starts feeling effortless before you even leave the house! Browse our favorite weekend bags and travel accessories designed to keep everything stylishly in place. SHOP ALL WEEKEND BAGS & ACCESSORIES

articles.summary: Some bags are cute. Some bags are practical. And then there’s the newly redesigned Hathaway Tote Bag which is both, without making a big deal about it. The Hathaway Tote and Small Hathaway Tote were designed for the days when you need your bag to keep up with your calendar, your wardrobe, and your “I might need this later” instincts. The soft premium quilted cotton is fully reversible (yes, really) with thoughtfully placed pockets, polished enough to make even a messy day look intentional. If you’ve been looking for a large tote bag that feels elevated but lives in the real world, meet your new favorite Vera Bradley tote bag and her smaller, equally capable sister. What Makes the Hathaway Different from Every Other Tote in My Closet? Let’s start with the obvious: it’s reversible! Yes. Fully. Reversible. One tote. Two looks. No drama. You get the beauty of our signature pattern play and the freedom to flip the mood whenever you want. Bright and expressive one day. Understated and polished, the next. Your muse doesn’t live in neutral. Neither should your bag. And because this is a Vera Bradley tote bag, the inside is just as well-made as the outside, with a quilted cotton lining, intentional structure, and plenty of pockets that don’t disappear into the abyss. Is The Hathaway Truly a Large Tote Bag? Absolutely! The sizing is very generous for anyone who needs the extra space. Hathaway Tote Bag Dimensions: • 14.0" w x 13.0" h x 6.5" d • 20.5" top width • 12.0" handle drop That 20.5" top width gives you plenty of room, so your laptop, planner, water bottle, cardigan, cosmetic case, and the book you swear you’ll finish can coexist peacefully. This is the large tote bag you reach for when your day has layers. What Fits Inside the Hathaway Tote Bag? Short answer: more than you think. Long answer: • Up to a 15" Laptop • A Full-Size Notebook or Planner • Organizer Pouches • Large Wallet • Glasses Case • A 20 oz. water bottle • Light Sweater or Scarf • Snacks (because obviously) • Small Tech Accessories And thanks to the interior slip pocket, your phone or keys won’t migrate to the bottom. Is This Tote Bag Structured or Slouchy? It’s that perfect in-between: Structured enough to stand tall, yet relaxed enough that it’s easy to carry even when full. The quilted cotton lining adds softness and stability, while the hidden magnetic closure helps keep everything secure without the need for fussing with zippers. What Makes The Hathaway a Great Vera Bradley Commuter Tote Bag? A true Vera Bradley commuter tote bag needs: ✔ Room for your laptop ✔ Comfortable shoulder drop ✔ Easy-access pockets ✔ Secure closure ✔ Style that works from coffee shop to conference room to gym The Hathaway checks every box. The 12" handle drop fits comfortably over your shoulder, even with a blazer or coat. The hidden magnetic closure keeps everything in place while staying easy to open during the rush between train/subway/bus stops or meetings. And because it’s reversible, it adapts to your workweek wardrobe without requiring backup. What is the Difference Between This and The Small Hathaway Tote Bag (Besides the Size)? The Small Hathaway is the perfect Vera Bradley tote bag when you don’t need to bring everything with you, just your essentials. Small Hathaway Tote Bag Dimensions: • 11.25" w x 13.0" h x 5.0" d • 18.0" top width • 12.0" handle drop Compact, not cramped. What Fits Inside The Small Hathaway Tote Bag? The Small Hathaway Tote Big is perfect for your everyday essentials: • Tablet or Slim Laptop • Small Wallet • Phone • Small Cosmetic Pouch • Sunglasses • Mini Notebook • Protein Bar • Lip Balm It’s ideal for lighter commute days, weekend outings, gallery hopping, or when you want something compact but still impactful. Best of all, it features the same reversible design, hidden magnetic closure, and cotton lining as her big sister. What are the Pocket Details for both Totes? Both the Hathaway and Small Hathaway Tote Bags feature: • Exterior slip pockets • Interior slip pockets The exterior pockets give you quick access to your phone or keys. Their interior pockets keep the essentials securely in place. Both bags are designed to keep up with your pace. How Do I Style These Tote Bags? Both of the Hathaway tote bags are highly adaptable to any look you choose. Pair either bag with • Denim and Sneakers • Tailored Trousers and a Silk Blouse • A Summer Dress and Sandals This isn’t a bag that completes your look. It collaborates with it. Is This My New Everyday Vera Bradley Tote Bag? The answer is yes if you need: • A true large Vera Bradley tote bag that handles real life. • A flexible commuter companion. • A reversible silhouette that doubles your styling options. • A bag that respects both craft and practicality. And if you lean toward lighter days and tighter edits? The Small Hathaway Tote Bag is waiting for you. Two Sides. All You! Some people believe you need a different bag for every version of yourself. We don’t. You contain multitudes. Your tote can, too. The Hathaway Tote Bag isn’t here to tell you who to be. It’s here to keep up with you and your needs. SHOP THE HATHAWAY TOTE BAG
